Test fixture: a handful of real rows from the source table of the World Atlas of
late Quaternary Foraminiferal Oxygen and Carbon Isotope Ratios (2022), chosen to
cover each kind of data source (PANGAEA, NOAA, laboratory, personal
communication, table in paper, paper supplement), a record with radiocarbon
references, and one core with two species.

Mulitza, S. et al. (2022): Data Sources for the World Atlas of late Quaternary
Foraminiferal Oxygen and Carbon Isotope Ratios 2021, Zenodo,
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6337519 (CC BY 4.0). Atlas: Mulitza et al. (2022),
Earth System Science Data 14, 2553-2611, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-14-2553-2022.
